<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>TMC symbol dispute:</strong> Mamata Banerjee has petitioned the Supreme Court to challenge the Election Commission’s interim order freezing the Trinamool Congress name and election symbol.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPaEFRczFrblFPbTh2T0RVOGU1QXVobE9tdmhmbTBiNWtRcnJWYlM5QlVhMld6ZmdXa09pNnJpS0NuNWQzTGpoSkVzN0duc2NPWEIySzhHTmExLTEzb2U3YlJqRFVtdGZYVnlHcTNXejFEanZEQmdMTks0YzctS2lJQ19rTy1VQkNpanBxM3czZjNveldYVnBnRlhOM2Z4Z3huQzMteDhJSVFBR00?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary discourse:</strong> Prime Minister Modi praised Home Minister Amit Shah’s recent Lok Sabha speech, highlighting its focus on parliamentary traditions and factual depth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNTHlMZGNZU3hPZVBXWFYzMGRQd2lQQ0l5SlVnVm1iMG1CVHNJQzZKZTM3Q1RIbzQ4Y0ZrZDd6YmdLd2FOTEkteG9XQVhRYUVSQ0NIRWVONktZZktKd2lVRWVxeFc5aG9MSTZaRl8zeUlBSjA1VVBuU3VlRUNra2Jhb2pJR1VRRjc2NTVvay1xcDV4QWhXdUFXVzR5cDB2U3ctS25GSWFFSHZCbUJPQ1FGOTBzTENHTThlU1FiRzBQbUtyNE45RElORnVuOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>New political ventures:</strong> Former MP Vijayasai Reddy has announced plans to launch a new political party in Andhra Pradesh, with a stated focus on youth, irrigation, and the Rayalaseema region.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

Murugan emphasized at the Jindal Policy Conclave that all public policy in India must be strictly guided by the Constitution.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
